headline: Ransomware Attack Targets Pacific Engineering Corporation
body: Pacific Engineering Corporation, a key player in the automotive parts manufacturing sector, has been hit by a ransomware attack. The attackers have threatened to release sensitive internal data unless a ransom is paid. Pacific Engineering Corporation is known for its contributions to the automotive industry, providing essential components to various manufacturers. The company is currently assessing the extent of the data breach and working with cybersecurity experts to contain the situation. While the attack has caused operational disruptions, there have been no reports of impact on downstream customers.
